method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; rules in the statute's terms, exported seat questions derived from them; no regulative rule (no deadline in the deposited sections); no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Miss. Code s 27-7-5 as amended by House Bill 1 (2025 Regular Session, approved 27 March 2025), with HB 1 Section 2; ss 27-7-17 and 27-7-21 as brought forward by House Bills 866 and 1996 (2026, as introduced, both died); all from billstatus.ls.state.ms.us, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the deposited texts are the Mississippi Legislature's bill documents (see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md, which flags the Secretary of State's copyright assertion for the owner)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run msit-cases.l4 ; l4 run msit.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Resident individuals, calendar years 2024 on: the rate on taxable income over $10,000 (s 27-7-5 as amended by HB 1 of 2025, with the Section 2 reductions from 2031 as an input), the personal and additional exemptions (s 27-7-21), the optional standard deduction (s 27-7-17(3)(b)), taxable income from income after business deductions. Out: nonresidents, gross income and business deductions in detail, itemized deductions in detail, credits, withholding, filing.
seat: the individual Mississippi resident taxpayer (or married couple living together)
